acceptanceCriteria: A valid already selected multi-hop lineage can be recovered and projected without creating a competing successor.

Every lineage edge binds repository identity, predecessor/successor Contract and Summary digests, Outcome and Events digests, archive and close digests, and exact provider PR/merge plus Runtime identity.
Original Contract, Summary, Outcome, Events, archive, verification, finalization, close, and recovery bytes are never edited or deleted.
Each recovered target requires explicit human actor, authority source, decision time, rationale, evidence references, and resume condition.
Missing, malformed, stale, foreign, digest-mismatched, competing, ambiguous, or incomplete lineage remains fail-closed and never becomes ordinary green.
CLI, MCP, English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese documentation, and focused regression tests expose identical semantics.
goal: Validate and project only the selected multi-hop lineage with exact repository, Contract, Summary, Outcome, Events, archive, close, finalization, PR, merge, and Runtime bindings while preserving every historical byte.
intent: Implement GitHub Issue #829: provide an append-only close recovery path for an already selected, unambiguous multi-hop successor lineage whose legacy predecessor or intermediate close/finalization receipts are invalid under the current projection.
outOfScope: weakening strict close/finalization or competing-successor validation
global Agent/MCP configuration and network delivery
risk: high: governance projection and immutable historical evidence

scenarioCoverage.expected: all selected edges and terminal evidence are bound without a competing successor
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: run focused positive recovery and status projection tests

scenarioCoverage.expected: foreign, stale, malformed, ambiguous, or missing evidence remains fail-closed
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: run focused negative recovery and status projection tests
